title: Document one portable host-owned review identity path and replace Questly's shell-only recipe
outcome: One portable review-identity procedure works for Engram, TermAl and Questly without incompatible project-specific fingerprint recipes
acceptance: Portable review guidance keeps Git identity as the default and, for a concrete raw-byte/submodule exception, documents exactly the host-owned termal_review_identity parent capture and reviewer check calls, including staged, unstaged, nonignored untracked and initialized-submodule coverage without reviewer shell commands.

Questly's custom length-framed candidate recipe is removed from review-code/review-changes and replaced by that supported host contract, with no source_id or project-digest substitution and no new review gate.

The active Questly review is unblocked by the existing MCP calls without waiting for the documentation change; each repository's documentation-only validation and review requirements remain unchanged.
disposal_reason: Duplicate of w-6aa60875ae71: the same Greg-directed portable review-identity instruction, filed in parallel by Fable at 02:40Z and already assigned to 11323. Kimi's concrete finding about Questly's recipe is copied onto w-6aa6.
